description: Generates a NEW segment that continues an existing video from its final frame and returns the new job's id immediately; the result is the original clip with the new segment joined on. WHEN: the user asks to extend, continue or lengthen a video, or wants to see what happens next in a clip they have. Call `list_models` first if you have not this session: `model` and the allowed `aspect_ratio`, `resolution` and `duration` come from there, and only models that can start from an image are accepted. `duration` is the length of the NEW segment, not of the finished video. Say in `prompt` what happens NEXT: a prompt describing the clip that exists produces a repeat of it. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), again at once while `terminal: false`, then one short line; no `get_*` polling, timers, background shells or narrating the wait. No card? Give the user the `url`. COST: this spends the user's tokens, priced like a normal generation of the new segment: the model, duration and resolution decide it, not the source clip's length.  An external url costs one media-ingest slot: quote and create from the SAME url to pay it once. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

aspect_ratio.description: One of the model's published `aspect_ratios`. REQUIRED: the server does not guess it from the source clip and it changes the price on some models. Match the source clip's shape unless the user asked otherwise.

audio.description: Generate audio for the new segment, on the models that support it (`list_models` says whether sound costs extra). IT DEFAULTS TO FALSE: the segment is SILENT unless you set it. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

duration.description: Length of the NEW segment in seconds, one of the model's published durations; longer costs more. REQUIRED: if the user gave none, put your pick and its price in the priced ask; never one chosen to save tokens, never carried over.

model.description: Model id exactly as `list_models` returns it. Use the one the user asked for; never substitute a cheaper model to save them tokens.

prompt.description: What should happen in the NEW segment.

resolution.description: One of the model's published options; higher costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

source_video.description: URL of the video to continue. A URL from this account's generations or uploads, or a public https URL (imported first); another account's is refused.

name: extend_video
title: Continue a video past its ending
